channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Tiger and Spieth, Part 3: The cut streak
item.description: In the third part of Jordan Spieth's interview with Tiger Woods, Woods talks about his record cuts-made streak and the pride he took in never giving up.

item.title: How to define genius? Even the best have a hard time
item.description: Brandel Chamblee talks to Damon Hack on "Golf Central Pregame" on how even the greatest athletes -- like Scottie Scheffler -- have a hard time explaining genius.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler picks up steam at Riviera, sees slow starts as 'small sample size'
item.description: The world No. 1 told reporters after shooting a 5-under 66 at the third round of the Genesis Invitational that he was confident in his game despite three consecutive slow starts that have left him grinding his way up leaderboard this month.

item.title: Genesis Invitational 2026: Final-round tee times, pairings, and how to watch
item.description: The final 18 holes at Riviera Country Club will determine who wins the biggest slice of the Genesis Invitational's $20 million purse. Here's how to watch Jacob Bridgeman, Rory McIlroy, and more on Sunday.

item.title: Jacob Bridgeman delivers brilliant performance at Riviera to build a 6-shot lead over Rory McIlroy
item.description: Jacob Bridgeman sure didn’t play as though he had not won on the PGA Tour. The 26-year-old from Clemson carries a six-stroke lead over Rory McIlroy into Sunday's final round.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Genesis Invitational, Round 3
item.description: Extended highlights from the third round of the PGA Tour's Genesis Invitational, where Jacob Bridgeman built a big lead but Rory McIlroy gave himself a chance.

item.title: Bridgeman closing in on first Tour win: 'Doing this at Riviera is a dream'
item.description: Jacob Bridgeman got a lot closer to his first PGA Tour victory by shooting a 7-under 64 in Saturday's third round at Riviera Country Club. Bridgeman carries a six-stroke lead over Rory McIlroy entering Sunday.

item.title: McIlroy on final pairing at Genesis: 'That’s all I can ask for'
item.description: Rory McIlroy finished with seven consecutive pars at Riviera Country Club on Saturday. He trails Jacob Bridgeman, his final round partner, by six strokes. It's familiar territory for the world's No. 2-ranked player. He rallied to beat Scottie Scheffler in the Tour Championship in 2023 to win the FedEx Cup.

item.title: Moving Day: Bridgeman steers six clear at Genesis
item.description: Jacob Bridgeman shot his second straight 64 Saturday at the 2026 Genesis Invitational to make the biggest move on Moving Day.

item.title: Riviera as playoff venue? That’s on table, and what that could mean for next year’s schedule
item.description: Tiger Woods, Genesis’ host and a player director on the Tour’s policy board, did confirm that moving his event to the end of the season, perhaps into the playoff rotation alongside potentially new venues, was among ideas still “on the table.”
